uc-davis.title: World-first in-utero stem-cell therapy for fetal spina bifida repair
uc-davis.contribution: UC Davis Health performed the world's first spina bifida treatment combining fetal surgery with a placental stem-cell patch, moving fetal surgery toward regenerative therapy for congenital disease.
uc-davis.writer_note: Good for a why-school paragraph about translational surgery, regenerative medicine, and maternal-fetal innovation.

ucsd.title: Development of green fluorescent protein into a transformative biological imaging tool
ucsd.contribution: UC San Diego's Roger Tsien shared the 2008 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for work that made GFP broadly useful for tracking proteins, cells, and biological processes.
ucsd.writer_note: Strong tie-in if you want to discuss molecular tools, visualization, and basic science becoming everyday biomedical infrastructure.

kaiser-permanente.title: Large-scale vaccine safety and effectiveness science through the Vaccine Safety Datalink
kaiser-permanente.contribution: Kaiser Permanente is a major partner in the CDC Vaccine Safety Datalink, using integrated clinical data to monitor vaccine safety and study rare adverse events at population scale.
kaiser-permanente.writer_note: Useful for writing about learning medicine inside a system that turns care delivery data into public-health evidence.

temple.title: Discovery of hepatitis B virus and development of prevention tools at Fox Chase
temple.contribution: Fox Chase Cancer Center, now part of Temple Health, was the site of Baruch Blumberg's Nobel-recognized hepatitis B work, including discovery of the virus and development of blood-screening and vaccine pathways.
temple.writer_note: Excellent microbio/infectious-disease anchor for Temple if you mention Fox Chase carefully as a Temple Health affiliate.

emory.title: Emory-discovered HIV medicines used in modern antiretroviral therapy
emory.contribution: Emory scientists invented the HIV drugs Emtriva and 3TC, medicines that became core components of lifesaving antiretroviral therapy.
emory.writer_note: Very strong fit for microbio, translational drug discovery, and global public health.

virginia-tech-carilion.title: Dalbavancin treatment strategy for Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia
virginia-tech-carilion.contribution: Virginia Tech Carilion-affiliated investigators contributed to the DOTS randomized clinical trial evaluating dalbavancin for complicated S. aureus bacteremia.
virginia-tech-carilion.writer_note: Use as an infectious-disease/microbiology example rather than as a long historical institutional claim.

vermont-larner.title: Global burden estimates for lower respiratory infections
vermont-larner.contribution: Larner-affiliated scholarship contributed to a Lancet Infectious Diseases systematic analysis estimating the global burden and etiologies of lower respiratory infections.
vermont-larner.writer_note: Good for connecting infectious disease to population health and global burden measurement.

wisconsin.title: Vitamin D fortification process that helped eliminate rickets as a common disease
wisconsin.contribution: UW-Madison biochemist Harry Steenbock discovered that ultraviolet irradiation increased vitamin D in foods, a breakthrough that enabled food fortification and helped eradicate rickets worldwide.
wisconsin.writer_note: A clean example of basic biochemistry becoming a population-level preventive medicine tool.

mcw.title: The Quick test for standardized coagulation measurement
mcw.contribution: Medical College of Wisconsin's Armand Quick discovered the Quick test, the first standardized assay for measuring coagulation beyond whole-blood clotting time.
mcw.writer_note: Useful if you want a concise example of laboratory medicine shaping modern clinical diagnostics.

jefferson-kimmel.title: Azithromycin to reduce sepsis or death around vaginal birth
jefferson-kimmel.contribution: Jefferson-affiliated investigators contributed to a major New England Journal of Medicine multicenter study of azithromycin to prevent maternal sepsis or death in planned vaginal birth.
jefferson-kimmel.writer_note: A women's-health and infection-prevention example that is much more useful than a generic Jefferson research claim.

miami-miller.title: The Ricordi method for isolating pancreatic islet cells
miami-miller.contribution: The Miller School's cellular transplantation work is associated with the Ricordi method, a major advance in islet-cell isolation for diabetes research and transplantation.
miami-miller.source_label: University of Miami Miller School of Medicine
miami-miller.writer_note: Good for translational science, diabetes, cell processing, and bench-to-bedside medicine.

wake-forest.title: First laboratory-grown organ successfully implanted in human patients
wake-forest.contribution: Wake Forest Institute for Regenerative Medicine reported the first laboratory-grown organ, engineered bladder tissue, successfully implanted in patients.
wake-forest.writer_note: A major regenerative-medicine contribution and a strong why-school anchor.

albany.title: Training lineage connected to the discovery of leptin
albany.contribution: Albany Medical College graduate Jeffrey Friedman discovered leptin, a hormone that established a biological basis for obesity and opened new metabolic-disease research pathways.
albany.writer_note: This is an alumni contribution rather than a discovery made on Albany's campus, so phrase it carefully.

drexel.title: First degree-granting medical school for women
drexel.contribution: Drexel College of Medicine traces part of its lineage to Woman's Medical College of Pennsylvania, the first degree-granting medical school in the world for women.
drexel.writer_note: This is more a landmark contribution to medical education and scientific access than a single biomedical discovery.

wayne-state.title: Early evidence linking glucose, insulin secretion, and glucagon response
wayne-state.contribution: Wayne State School of Medicine faculty are credited with early evidence that glucose stimulates insulin secretion and that low glucose stimulates a blood-sugar-raising pancreatic factor, later understood through glucagon biology.
wayne-state.source_label: Wayne State School of Medicine profile
wayne-state.writer_note: Use as a metabolism/endocrine science example, but verify wording before making it a centerpiece.

loyola-stritch.title: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron attenuation biology
loyola-stritch.contribution: Stritch-affiliated research contributed to work identifying spike and nsp6 as key determinants of SARS-CoV-2 Omicron BA.1 attenuation.
loyola-stritch.writer_note: Good microbio/virology fit; frame as a recent contribution rather than a historic Loyola landmark.

quinnipiac-netter.title: Community-randomized trial on interrupting soil-transmitted helminth transmission
quinnipiac-netter.contribution: Netter-affiliated investigators contributed to the DeWorm3 community cluster-randomized trial testing whether mass drug administration can interrupt soil-transmitted helminth transmission.
quinnipiac-netter.writer_note: Useful for infectious disease, global health, and population-level intervention framing.

tulane.title: CDC evidence base for trichomoniasis diagnosis and management
tulane.contribution: Tulane-affiliated scholarship contributed to the evidence review behind CDC sexually transmitted infection guidance for Trichomonas vaginalis.
tulane.writer_note: A direct fit for microbiology, women's health, and public-health guideline writing.

eastern-virginia.title: First IVF baby born in the United States
eastern-virginia.contribution: EVMS's Jones Institute is responsible for the birth of the first in vitro fertilization baby in the United States, a landmark in reproductive medicine.

rush.title: Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project
rush.contribution: Rush developed major longitudinal clinical-pathologic cohort studies that transformed aging and Alzheimer disease research by linking annual clinical data with brain donation and molecular analyses.
rush.writer_note: Good for serious longitudinal patient-centered research and aging/hospice-adjacent reflection.

rosalind-franklin.title: Photo 51 and the structure of DNA as the university's scientific namesake
rosalind-franklin.contribution: The university is named for Rosalind Franklin, whose X-ray crystallography image Photo 51 was essential to resolving DNA's double-helix structure.
rosalind-franklin.writer_note: This is a namesake legacy, not an RFU campus discovery; use it as a values/history point, not as institutional research output.

new-york-medical-college.title: Training lineage connected to ivermectin's discovery
new-york-medical-college.contribution: NYMC's history highlights former professor William Campbell, a 2015 Nobel laureate for discovering ivermectin, which drastically reduced river blindness and lymphatic filariasis.
new-york-medical-college.writer_note: A strong infectious-disease/global-health connection, but phrase it as a former-faculty contribution.

uc-riverside.title: Decisive contributions to LIGO and gravitational-wave detection
uc-riverside.contribution: UC Riverside physicist Barry Barish won the 2017 Nobel Prize in Physics for decisive contributions to the LIGO detector and observation of gravitational waves.
uc-riverside.writer_note: Major science contribution from UCR broadly, not from the medical school; useful only if you want a research-culture sentence.

cusm.title: No verified major landmark contribution found yet
cusm.contribution: CUSM is a newer medical school; I did not find a credible institution-level discovery that should be presented as a major scientific contribution.
cusm.writer_note: Do not force a science prestige claim here; focus why-school writing on Inland Empire mission, social accountability, and newer-school fit.

umass-chan.title: Discovery of RNA interference
umass-chan.contribution: UMass Chan's Craig Mello shared the 2006 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for discovering RNA interference, a fundamental gene-regulation mechanism.
umass-chan.writer_note: Excellent for molecular biology, gene regulation, and therapeutics.

nova-southeastern-md.title: No verified major MD-school landmark contribution found yet
nova-southeastern-md.contribution: NSU MD is a newer allopathic program; I did not find a credible MD-school-level discovery that should be described as a major contribution to science.
nova-southeastern-md.writer_note: If you use research fit here, lean on current health-sciences strengths rather than claiming a landmark discovery.

roseman.title: No verified major medical-school landmark contribution found yet
roseman.contribution: Roseman University College of Medicine is newly accredited and recruiting its inaugural class, so I did not find a mature medical-school discovery record to cite.
roseman.writer_note: Use mission, community health innovation, and new-program fit rather than research prestige.

hackensack-meridian.title: Antibiotic-development infrastructure for drug-resistant infections
hackensack-meridian.contribution: Hackensack Meridian's Center for Discovery and Innovation received a major NIH grant to develop antibiotics for drug-resistant infections, reflecting a serious institutional contribution to antimicrobial research infrastructure.
hackensack-meridian.writer_note: Good microbio/antimicrobial-resistance fit, but describe as a research program contribution rather than a completed discovery.

belmont-frist.title: No verified medical-school scientific landmark found yet
belmont-frist.contribution: Belmont Frist is a new medical school, first announced in 2020; I did not find a mature scientific contribution that should be cited as a landmark.
belmont-frist.writer_note: Keep why-school writing focused on whole-person care, Nashville clinical partnerships, service learning, and new-school opportunity.

uicom.title: UIC drug-discovery work behind marketed HIV and bladder-cancer drugs
uicom.contribution: UIC describes a biopharmaceutical track record that includes marketed drug and drug-delivery successes, including an HIV drug and a bladder-cancer drug discovered at UIC.
uicom.writer_note: Useful for translational drug discovery; if you cite it in an essay, name the exact drug only after verifying the specific UIC source.

george-washington.title: Walter Reed's confirmation of mosquito transmission of yellow fever
george-washington.contribution: Walter Reed, an alumnus of the medical school, led the work confirming that yellow fever is transmitted by mosquitoes, a foundational infectious-disease and public-health discovery.
george-washington.writer_note: Very strong infectious-disease/public-health history, but phrase as an alumni contribution rather than a GW campus discovery.

california-northstate.title: No verified major medical-school scientific landmark found yet
california-northstate.contribution: California Northstate is a newer medical school, and I did not find a credible major scientific contribution worth citing for a secondary essay.
california-northstate.writer_note: Do not force research prestige here; focus on Northern California, primary care, patient-centeredness, and social accountability.
